title: AI Safeguards, Generative AI and the Pandora Box: AI Safety Measures to Protect Businesses and Personal Reputation
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical assessment and performance comparison of various Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN) models in detecting deepfakes and AI-generated content. While it addresses the social harm and safety risks associated with generative AI, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as a core research component.
